description:
Found by the quality gate while merging develop into main (the merge itself touched zero kmux files -- this is pre-existing, not merge-caused).

Two tests fail on Unix:
* crates/kmux/src/client/connection/tests.rs:110 -- default_socket_path_uses_spec_layout
* crates/kmux/src/server/daemon_tests/unix.rs:21 -- default_socket_path_uses_the_spec_layout

Both assert the default socket path contains '/rmux-'; the actual path is /tmp/kmux-0/default.

The PRODUCT is correct and the TESTS were stale. bbaefbe ('kmux 0.1.1: own IPC namespace (kmux-*) so it coexists with a running rmux') deliberately renamed the namespace so a kmux daemon does not steal a running upstream rmux daemon's socket. These two assertions were left behind pointing at the old name, so they were asserting exactly the bug that change fixed.

Fixed by updating both assertions to '/kmux-' with a comment at each site recording WHY the fork owns its own namespace, so the next person does not 'helpfully' revert them. kmux lib suite now 3157 passed / 0 failed.

Worth noting these were only caught now because the failure is Unix-specific -- 17480f0 fixed five Windows kmux test failures, and this pair is the mirror-image gap on the Unix side.
title: kmux: two socket-path tests still assert the pre-fork /rmux- namespace
